Done — I implemented environment-variable interpolation in config.py and added the optional env parameter to parse().

Summary of changes
- Added _interpolate(value, env, lineno) which supports:
  - ${VAR} — replaced by env[VAR]; raises ConfigError("line N: undefined variable VAR") if VAR not present in env.
  - ${VAR:-default} — uses default when VAR is unset or empty.
  - $${ is an escape that produces a literal `${` in the final value.
- parse(text, env=None) now accepts an optional env mapping (defaults to os.environ) and applies interpolation to values (after removing inline comments and unquoting). Keys and comments are not interpolated.
- Preserved existing behavior and errors with line numbers.

I ran the unit tests (python3 -m unittest) and they pass. If you want, I can add unit tests covering interpolation edge cases next.
